title: Road to S+
notes: NEW RANKS: B, A, S and S+. Each has its own gate (Abyssal Rift, Tempest Spire, Sunken Sun, Eclipse Throne) with new monsters, an elite and a boss, plus 5 arena hunters and a rank exam.
NEW: Master League. Beat the Master Trial at S+ and climb from Master Lv 1 to 99. Every level pays Gold, XP, Stones, Diamonds and an item, every 10th level is a wall.
New gear sets: Abyssborn, Tempest, Solar Crown and Eclipse.
Slower, longer game: levels need more XP early on (reaching B takes a good while now), while high levels stay reachable so you never fall behind the enemies.
Recommended Power for the new gates is tuned with test runs. Balancing of the high ranks continues every hour.
